item.title: U.S. military strikes Iran, while Trump vows more for Tehran's retaliation
item.description: The U.S. military hit targets in Iran on Tuesday and Tehran fired missiles and drones at various sites across the region in response as hostilities flare once again in an intermittent war.

item.title: Israel bars U.S. citizens over criticism and ties to Palestinian activists, lawyers say
item.description: Travelers from the U.S. and other nations are denied entry to Israel after interrogations about their links to Palestinians, plans to visit the occupied West Bank and opinions of Israel, lawyers say.

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: U.S. military strikes rock Iran for a second day in a row, Trump attempts to combat rising gas prices as midterm approaches, Sen. Ed Markey wins Massachusetts' Democratic primary.

item.title: How will tariffs affect the midterms? In this Michigan border town, it's complicated
item.description: The recent trade war between the U.S. and Canada has both economic and political implications for Michigan given it's the state's top trade partner.

item.title: Incumbent Sen. Ed Markey wins Massachusetts' Democratic primary for US Senate
item.description: Bucking a push for younger leadership this election season, Sen. Ed Markey, 80, won the Democratic nomination against Rep. Seth Moulton, 47, who said that his party needed new leaders.

item.title: North Carolina Rep. Chuck Edwards is formally censured over harassment allegations
item.description: The censure vote drew bipartisan support, and followed an investigation by the House Ethics Committee into allegations of sexual harassment against two young female staff members.
